dominance_rules.action: hold the piece; complete the card or mark fields unknown-held, and let the line's refusal right stand

anti_rework_rules.rule: Photograph and log condition before any handling or wiping
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unwinnable disputes over pre-existing damage and the loss of the only before-state evidence

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the substrate family with two agreeing methods before any routing decision
anti_rework_rules.prevents: whole-stack adhesion failures and dissolved pieces caused by treating stainless as mild steel or pot metal as brass

anti_rework_rules.rule: Inventory stones, pearls, and organics before selecting any test location or route
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reagent wicking into foils and glue, and mid-job discoveries that void the verdict

anti_rework_rules.rule: Transcribe every mark before any polishing or stripping plan is made
anti_rework_rules.prevents: hallmark loss that no later step can undo and the disputes and legal exposure that follow it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Map existing coatings before interpreting any surface test
anti_rework_rules.prevents: booking the coating's chemistry as the core's identity and planning the job on a false substrate

anti_rework_rules.rule: Finish every risk-zone survey before the verdict is issued
anti_rework_rules.prevents: accept verdicts that a later joint, trap, or antique finding forces into embarrassing reversal

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain the irreversibility sign-off before the piece leaves the triage bench
anti_rework_rules.prevents: mid-job stops waiting for consent and irreversible work performed on assumed agreement

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record mixed-substrate assemblies component by component
anti_rework_rules.prevents: one-family route cards that send a steel spring or soft-soldered finding through chemistry meant for the body metal

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write unknowns as unknown-held on the route card, never as plausible guesses
anti_rework_rules.prevents: downstream benches trusting a guessed entry with the card's full authority and building failure on it

iteration_protocol.trigger: a downstream adhesion, dissolution, or joint failure is traced to a triage miss
iteration_protocol.action: update the failure map entry, tighten the owning ladder rung, and re-verify queued pieces assessed under the old habit

iteration_protocol.trigger: the line rejects a route card or finds a surprise under old plate
iteration_protocol.action: return the piece to re-examination with the query attached and add the missing field or evidence habit to the card and checklist

iteration_protocol.trigger: an organics loss or near-miss occurs anywhere in the shop
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the inventory and disposition rules that let it through, and drill the organics-first veto on test placement

iteration_protocol.trigger: a counterfeit or transplanted mark reaches the verdict stage
iteration_protocol.action: add the pattern to the mark-reading guide, brief the bench, and audit recent verdicts that leaned on similar marks

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new instrument, kit class, or test capability becomes available
iteration_protocol.action: re-order the ladder's rungs around the new cost-certainty tradeoff and retire screens it obsoletes

iteration_protocol.trigger: a consent or handover dispute exposes a gap in disclosure or sign-off wording
iteration_protocol.action: revise the disclosure record and authorization templates so the gap is named before acceptance next time

iteration_protocol.trigger: a jurisdiction rule change touches nickel release, consumer consent, or bench chemical obligations
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the affected obligation classes, update the flags and templates, and date the rule check

iteration_protocol.trigger: refusal-rate drift suggests the verdict criteria have gone too loose or too tight
iteration_protocol.action: review a sample of verdicts against outcomes, recalibrate the accept-with-conditions boundary, and restate the criteria
